Maya Chen: morning — quick async standup for API gateway / routing / auth / rate limits
Elliot Brooks: done: landed auth-proxy change to preserve kid header; rolled to staging :white_check_mark:
Elliot Brooks: blocker: intermittent 502s from mobile when trace metadata present, trying to repro locally with instrumented proxy
Samir Patel: done: deployed route-splitting canary to us-east-1 (3% traffic); saw a small 429 spike at 10:42
Samir Patel: logs:
```
2026-02-20T10:42:13Z gateway[ingress]: 429 Too Many Requests - route=product-search shard=7
2026-02-20T10:42:14Z gateway[ingress]: 200 OK - route=product-search shard=2
```
Jules (InfraBot): [deploy] canary:route-split v1.8 started by Samir Patel — canary 3%
Maya Chen: note: if 429s line up with cache misses on prefixes, toggle prefix_kv_warmup for that rule. @Samir can you try? :mag:
Samir Patel: toggling now, command:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api/reconfigure -d '{"route":"product-search","prefix_kv_warmup":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
Samir Patel: warmup enabled, rerunning wrk load for 5m — will post results
Elliot Brooks: fyi PR #4321 contains the kid-preserve fix. @Priya can you review when free? small patch + one unit test
Priya Nair: will review in ~45m; plan: add unit test for kid-preserve and a regression that simulates mobile trace header combos
Maya Chen: ops ask: add a dashboard panel for per-route token burn rate and an alert (INF-1299). helps us see 429 root causes vs global ratepolicy
Samir Patel: filed INF-1299 and pushed initial grafana query to the card
Elliot Brooks: if 502s persist after kid fix, I suspect auth-proxy hitting a retry/timeout path. I can increase proxy timeout + add extra debug logs for next canary
Priya Nair: ack — I'll watch staging after review. If we still see 502s, we can spin a 10m sync on #eng-platform-call
Maya Chen: thanks. If nothing urgent, we'll reconvene EOD. :thumbsup:
